goalOneSentence: Verify a four-server mocker estate where auth, catalog, cart, and checkout HTTP mocks run on ports 8221-8224 with a Redis controller and are all asserted hermetially in one runner session.
portContract: This sprint's mocker hosts FOUR Http servers. Ports MUST be exactly 8221 (auth), 8222 (catalog), 8223 (cart), 8224 (checkout). Runner transactions must target http://127.0.0.1:8221 through http://127.0.0.1:8224. Do NOT use any other ports. Redis controller uses localhost:6379 (infra-managed container).

tasks.title: Scaffold runner and mocker projects
tasks.description: Create two .NET 10 console projects: Runner/Runner.csproj and Mocker/Mocker.csproj. Runner.csproj must PackageReference QaaS.Runner Version 4.5.1, QaaS.Common.Assertions Version 3.5.1, and QaaS.Common.Generators Version 3.5.1. Mocker.csproj must PackageReference QaaS.Mocker Version 2.4.1 and QaaS.Common.Processors Version 1.5.1. Each Program.cs must contain exactly one line: Runner uses QaaS.Runner.Bootstrap.New(args).Run() and Mocker uses QaaS.Mocker.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(). Both csproj must set OutputType Exe and TargetFramework net10.0. Runner csproj must include None Update='*.qaas.yaml' CopyToOutputDirectory=Always item. Mocker csproj must include None Update='*.mocker.yaml' CopyToOutputDirectory=Always item. Do not add any placeholder code or TODO comments.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build exits 0 for both Runner and Mocker
rubric: Correct NuGet versions per FB s13#9
failureModes: Wrong package version (e.g. QaaS.Common.Assertions 4.5.1 instead of 3.5.1)

tasks.title: Author mocker YAML with four servers and Redis controller
tasks.description: Create Mocker/ecommerce.mocker.yaml defining four distinct Http servers and a Redis-connected controller. Server 1: Port 8221, Endpoint Path /auth/token, Method Get, one Action with Name AuthAction and TransactionStubName AuthStub. Server 2: Port 8222, Endpoint Path /catalog/items, Method Get, one Action with Name CatalogAction and TransactionStubName CatalogStub. Server 3: Port 8223, Endpoint Path /cart/status, Method Get, one Action with Name CartAction and TransactionStubName CartStub. Server 4: Port 8224, Endpoint Path /checkout/status, Method Get, one Action with Name CheckoutAction and TransactionStubName CheckoutStub. Under Stubs, each stub uses Processor StaticResponseProcessor with ProcessorConfiguration key (NOT TransactionData - that is the outdated docs key, FB s13#1 drift trap). AuthStub ProcessorConfiguration: Body a JSON token string, StatusCode 200, ContentType application/json. CatalogStub: Body a JSON items array, StatusCode 200. CartStub: Body a JSON count object, StatusCode 200. CheckoutStub: Body a JSON orderId object, StatusCode 200. Add a Controller section at root with ServerName ecommerce-mesh and Redis Endpoint 127.0.0.1:6379. All Endpoint Path values must be all-lowercase (FB s13#5b). YAML root keys are Servers, Stubs, Controller. Server and Endpoint entries have NO Name property (FB s13#21) - only Actions and Stubs are named.
acceptanceCriteria: No 'not found in' errors in output
rubric: Four Http servers each on unique ports 8221-8224
failureModes: Using TransactionData instead of ProcessorConfiguration (FB s13#1)
Uppercase letters in route paths (FB s13#5b)
Missing Controller section or wrong ServerName

tasks.title: Author runner YAML targeting all four servers with hermetic assertions
tasks.description: Create Runner/ecommerce.qaas.yaml plus four one-line JSON payload files: Runner/TestData/auth/payload.json, Runner/TestData/catalog/payload.json, Runner/TestData/cart/payload.json, Runner/TestData/checkout/payload.json (each a tiny JSON object like {"probe":"auth"}). The YAML has Storages [- FileSystem: {Path: ./session-data}] and four DataSources: AuthData -> FileSystem {Path: TestData/auth}, CatalogData -> FileSystem {Path: TestData/catalog}, CartData -> FileSystem {Path: TestData/cart}, CheckoutData -> FileSystem {Path: TestData/checkout}; every DataSource uses Generator FromFileSystem with GeneratorConfiguration.FileSystem holding ONLY Path (NO Pattern key exists in FileSystemConfig, FB s13#20 - scoping is done by giving each DataSource its own subfolder with exactly one file so every transaction gets exactly one input). One Session named FourServerSession with four Http transactions, each with TimeoutMs 5000 and its own DataSourceNames list: AuthTx (BaseAddress http://127.0.0.1:8221, Method Get, Route auth/token, DataSourceNames [AuthData]); CatalogTx (8222, catalog/items, [CatalogData]); CartTx (8223, cart/status, [CartData]); CheckoutTx (8224, checkout/status, [CheckoutData]). Transactions ALWAYS require DataSourceNames or DataSourcePatterns regardless of HTTP method (FB s13#3). Each transaction has two assertions: (1) HermeticByExpectedOutputCount with ExpectedCount 1 and OutputNames [the transaction name] (prevents vacuous HttpStatus pass, FB s13#12); (2) HttpStatus with StatusCode 200 and OutputNames as a YAML list (FB s13#4 drift: OutputNames list, not OutputName scalar). Routes must be all-lowercase with no leading slash (FB s13#5b). Add a MockerCommands entry: Name RepointAuth, ServerName ecommerce-mesh (byte-match to the mocker Controller.ServerName), Command: ChangeActionStub {ActionName: AuthAction, StubName: AuthStub} (idempotent re-point to the same stub), Redis: {Host: 127.0.0.1:6379}.
acceptanceCriteria: Template validation exits 0 with no schema errors
All four transaction routes are lowercase with no leading slash
rubric: Four transactions each targeting correct port
HermeticByExpectedOutputCount present on all four transactions
HttpStatus OutputNames is a list (not scalar)
Four DataSources each scoped to an own subfolder; no Pattern key used
MockerCommands uses ChangeActionStub with ActionName AuthAction / StubName AuthStub and ServerName ecommerce-mesh
failureModes: Missing HermeticByExpectedOutputCount allows vacuous pass (FB s13#12)
OutputName scalar instead of OutputNames list (FB s13#4)
Wrong BaseAddress port for a transaction
Pattern key anywhere in FromFileSystem config (does not exist; FB s13#20) - scope with subfolders instead
Sharing one TestData folder across DataSources multiplies outputs and breaks ExpectedCount 1
TriggerAction against an Http server is a runtime error - use ChangeActionStub

tasks.title: Live run gate: start mocker, probe all four ports, run runner suite
tasks.description: Start the mocker from the Mocker subdirectory using Start-Process dotnet with WorkingDirectory Mocker and ArgumentList run -c Release -- run ecommerce.mocker.yaml. After launch, poll each of the four TCP ports 8221 8222 8223 8224 with Net.Sockets.TcpClient in a retry loop of up to 40 iterations with 2-second delays per iteration. If any port is not responding after all retries, stop the mocker process and exit with code 9 to signal infrastructure failure rather than logic failure. Once all four ports respond, change to the Runner directory using Push-Location Runner, execute dotnet run -c Release -- run ecommerce.qaas.yaml to run the full runner session against all four servers, capture the dotnet process exit code in $code, return to the prior directory with Pop-Location, stop the mocker process with Stop-Process Id Force ErrorAction SilentlyContinue, and finally exit with the captured $code so the harness receives the runner result. All four count guards and all HttpStatus assertions must pass for exit 0.

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','ecommerce.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory 'Mocker' -PassThru; $ok=$false; foreach($i in 1..40){$r=$true; foreach($p in @(8221,8222,8223,8224)){try{(New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1',$p)).Close()}catch{$r=$false}}; if($r){$ok=$true;break}; Start-Sleep 2}; if(-not $ok){Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9}; Push-Location Runner; dotnet run -c Release -- run ecommerce.qaas.yaml; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Pop-Location; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

acceptanceCriteria: All four mocker ports become available within 80 seconds
Runner session exits 0 with all four count guards satisfied
rubric: Mocker starts and all four ports respond
Runner exits 0 with no assertion failures
Mocker process is stopped cleanly after run
failureModes: Controller ServerName mismatch prevents controller commands (FB s13#11)
Mocker fails to start due to Redis unavailable on 6379
Port 8221-8224 not all responding if YAML has wrong ports
